capex_verdict: The Rs 689cr productive asset base (fixed + CWIP) vs Rs 151cr in FY24 is a 4.6x expansion — almost certainly the Biax dielectric film line. If it ramps to 15% ROCE it generates ~Rs 100cr EBIT, but even that (at 25x) only supports ~Rs 900/share. The current price needs more than full utilization — it needs record margins on record volumes simultaneously.

A price correction toward Rs 300-500 (still above FV but closer to a watchable range)
Promoter buying or pledge disclosure (currently undisclosed)

thesis: Xpro India (polymer processing, dielectric/Biax films) is in a massive capex cycle: fixed assets Rs 179cr→Rs 390cr, CWIP Rs 299cr, borrowings Rs 39cr→Rs 325cr. The new Biax dielectric capacity could be transformative — but the stock at Rs 1,096 (78.7x TTM P/E, 3.38x book, 116x normalized earnings) prices in perfection: 2.9x current sales at 12% margins, or margins above the all-time 15% peak. ROCE has collapsed 25%→4%, OPM 15%→6%, other income is 60% of PBT, and FCF is deeply negative two years running. Kacholia's steady 3.9% and C5=2 credibility are genuine positives, but they don't fix a 4-5x overvaluation. This is a 'great story, wrong price' — revisit if the Biax ramp delivers AND the price corrects toward Rs 200-300.
